M1.denominator_description: Accepted nameplate assets with readable text
M1.definition: Percentage of accepted assets where target data fields (model, serial, manufacturer, etc.) are correctly extracted. High-confidence predictions must be accurate >= 85% of the time.
M1.prohibited_conflation: DO NOT label OCR accuracy as M1. Technical execution order (running OCR before extraction) does not make OCR Milestone 1.

M2.condition: known nameplate type with an active rule
M2.definition: Percentage of processable nameplates on known asset types with an active rule where OCR correctly recognizes nameplate text.
M2.prohibited_conflation: DO NOT label Extraction accuracy as M2.
